evidence.interpretation: No tensor/matrix pipeline usage; matmul runs on regular vector ALUs, reducing achievable math throughput.

fixes.fix: Retune/rewrite kernel to use MFMA/tensor-core path for fp16/bf16 (Triton configs/intrinsics that lower to matrix instructions).
fixes.rationale: Engaging matrix units typically raises compute utilization substantially for GEMM on CDNA3.
